verdict.rationale: LM Studio is primarily a local model runtime and platform, not solely an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows LM Studio acting as an MCP client (installing and connecting MCP servers for use with local models). That is the separate client-side capability and does not count toward this server story. No first-party MCP server or 'mcp serve' mode is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
